blocks.text: Cagayan De Oro 1st District Rep. Lordan Suan has categorically denied claims on social media insinuating he would file a "shoot-to-kill" resolution for Sen. Ronald "Bato" Dela Rosa, who remains in hiding from an International Criminal Court warrant for his arrest.
